name: Huly
summary: Midnight workspace interface with iris-blue and ember-coral aurora accents, pill-first controls, graphite product surfaces, and alternating dark/light product storytelling sections.

colors.name: Obsidian Canvas
colors.role: Page background and dominant dark surface.

colors.name: Void
colors.role: Deepest hero base and modal backdrop tone.

colors.name: Charcoal Card
colors.role: Elevated dark card and product panel surface.

colors.name: Slate Edge
colors.role: Hairline borders and dividers on dark surfaces.

colors.name: Electric Iris
colors.role: Primary action background, active navigation indicator, and cool aurora stop.

colors.name: Ember Pulse
colors.role: Secondary warm accent, notification dots, and aurora heat.

colors.name: Snow
colors.role: Primary text on dark surfaces and light-section canvas.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.role: Functional UI text, body, nav, buttons, lists, captions, and small headings.

fonts.name: Esbuild
fonts.role: Display-only hero headlines, section openers, and major feature titles.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.role: Main CTA or top-level conversion action.

dos: Use full pill radius for buttons, tags, and pill controls.
Reserve Esbuild for display moments at 28px and above.
Choose dark or light surface mode before composing a section.
Use Electric Iris for the single most important action per screen.
Use Ember Pulse as warm punctuation in tags, dots, and gradient stops.
Use aurora gradients as narrow beams or localized glows.
Alternate dark and light bands with generous vertical rhythm.
donts: Do not use sharp corners on buttons or tags.
Do not apply the aurora gradient as a full-surface background.
Do not introduce a third accent color.
Do not rely on heavy shadows for dark-card elevation.
Do not use Esbuild below 28px or in body copy.
Do not ship low-contrast dark or light text combinations.
surfaces: Dark product sections use Void and Charcoal Card surfaces; editorial sections switch to white and linen bands with the same iris/ember accent logic.
elevation: Prefer borders, surface contrast, and restrained glow over heavy shadows.
imagery: Product screenshots and real UI previews are the primary hero assets; avoid generic stock imagery.
layout: Use a dark hero with a narrow aurora beam, product preview evidence, pill navigation, and alternating dark/light sections with generous 96px vertical rhythm.
